order: Ship the harness's own skills with the master and have the installer place them. Add three orchestra-namespaced skills: a live harness state report, a plan-file author sized to the plan section's rules, and an on-demand adversarial review of arbitrary changes, plus an authoring template that stays underscore-prefixed and is never installed. Stamp each skill directory into the project's skills folder wholesale on every install so stale files cannot linger. On uninstall, remove exactly the names the master knows, leave any skill the user authored under another name untouched, and prune the skills directory once it is empty. State in the governing document that these skills are orchestration-class and safe for the Director to invoke in its own context, and document the lifecycle, the namespace, and how to bundle a new one in the README.
claims: Done. Three skills plus a never-installed authoring template are in the master, and the installer stamps them wholesale into the project's skills folder, removes only the master-known names on uninstall, and prunes the directory when it empties. Verified with node --check on the installer and the hooks, and with a full install then uninstall into a scratch project: both printed their expected summary lines.
